title: Fraser Valley Social Wine Tasting Private Tour
blurb:
This is a private tour with a local guide.
Grapes and wine production is one of the fast growing industries in British Columbia. Our VQA wines are comparable to some of the famous wines of California. The local wineries are located in the Fraser Valley just outside of the city it is a great way to spend a relaxing time in a beautiful country setting. ( Wineries don't ship wine to USA)
